name: Abhirup Kumar
description: Abhirup Kumar is a software developer based in Gurugram, Haryana, India, and a Computer Science & Engineering graduate of Adamas University. He builds web applications, AI tools, and systems software.
hometown: Tarakeswar, near Kolkata, West Bengal, India

projects.title: Distributed Linux Kernel Attestation System
projects.problem: Building a distributed system to verify Linux kernel integrity in real-time using loadable kernel modules, Netlink communication, and quorum-based consensus to detect unauthorized kernel modifications.
features: Real-time kernel integrity monitoring via LKM
Netlink-based kernel-userspace communication
Quorum-based consensus engine for distributed attestation
Cryptographic signing and verification of reports
HTTP API for attestation report collection
Trusted baseline management with operator prompts
Structured audit logging and security alerts
Secure Boot support with MOK key enrollment
projects.role: Control Node & Attestation Server developer. Designed kernel-space monitoring architecture, implemented Netlink protocol communication, built consensus engine, and created HTTP-based control plane with cryptographic verification.

projects.title: CharmCrafter
projects.problem: A modern web application built with React and TypeScript, featuring a responsive UI with shadcn-ui components and Supabase backend integration.
features: Modern React architecture with TypeScript
Responsive UI with shadcn-ui components
Supabase backend integration
Tailwind CSS styling with custom configuration
projects.role: Sole developer.  Built with Lovable platform, implemented TypeScript-based React application with modern tooling and design system.

projects.title: University Notes Platform
projects.problem: Building a comprehensive platform for managing and sharing university course notes with modern web technologies and database integration.
features: User authentication & authorization
Note organization and management
Database-driven content storage
Responsive modern interface
projects.role: Sole developer. Designed database schema, built full-stack application with TypeScript, and deployed to production.

projects.title: Formethica - AI-Powered Form Builder
projects.problem: Building an intelligent form creation platform with AI-powered field suggestions, chatbot assistance, and advanced submission management with analytics and export capabilities.
features: AI-powered form creation with smart field suggestions
Interactive AI chatbot for form building assistance
User authentication with anonymous & authenticated modes
Advanced submission management with Excel/CSV export
Link shortening with click analytics
Real-time form updates and response tracking
projects.role: Sole developer.  Designed database schema with RLS policies, integrated Google Gemini AI for intelligent suggestions, built responsive glassmorphism UI, and implemented full-stack features.

projects.title: Femway - Women's Safety Car Booking Platform
projects.problem: Building a secure, role-based car booking platform specifically designed for women's safety and comfort, with admin verification, driver management, and passenger protection features.
features: Role-based access control (Passenger, Driver, Admin)
Secure authentication with 24-hour session management
Admin verification system with secure codes
Driver verification and document management
Real-time ride booking and tracking
Row Level Security (RLS) on all database tables
projects.role: Sole developer. Designed secure database schema with RLS policies, implemented role-based authentication with admin code verification, built three distinct dashboards, and created responsive UI focused on safety.

projects.title: Study Notes Viewer
projects.problem: Building a modern web application for managing and organizing study notes with embedded content support, progress tracking, and rich markdown rendering capabilities.
features: Dynamic note display with grid layout
Progress filtering (completed, in-progress, not-started)
Embedded YouTube videos and Google Drive documents
Markdown support with code syntax highlighting
Responsive design with smooth animations
Intuitive note viewing and navigation
projects.role: Sole developer. Designed component architecture, implemented markdown rendering with rehype plugins, integrated embedded content support, and created animated responsive UI.

projects.title: Nexterm
projects.problem: Building an AI-powered terminal emulator that brings intelligent assistance to command-line workflows with natural language processing, error explanations, and context-aware suggestions.
features: Full terminal emulation with PTY support
AI-powered natural language command translation
Dual AI provider support (Ollama & Google Gemini)
Smart command history with fuzzy search
Syntax highlighting & danger detection
Privacy-focused data sanitization
projects.role: Sole developer.  Designed terminal architecture, implemented AI integration with multiple providers, built TUI with ratatui, and created security features for data sanitization.
